sermon.title: What is the Greatest Sin?
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Not loving God is the greatest sin, since it breaks the greatest commandment. Jesus said those who love Him keep His commandments and sayings. The blood of Christ forgives all sin, so get up and obey.

And in Matthew 22:37 Jesus tells us what the greatest sin is you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart with all your soul with all your mind. This is the first and great commandment.

scriptures.text_nkjv: He who has My commandments and keeps them, it is he who loves Me. And he who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and manifest Myself to him.”
“If you love Me, keep My commandments.

Jesus answered and said to him, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him. He who does not love Me does not keep My words; and the word which you hear is not Mine but the Father’s who sent Me.

scriptures.text_nkjv: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep His commandments. For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome.
If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

faqs.question: Isn’t blasphemy against the Holy Ghost the greatest sin?
faqs.answer: That is what people usually say; he points to the greatest commandment instead.

faqs.question: What is the first and great commandment?
faqs.answer: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul and mind.

faqs.question: So what is the greatest sin?
How does Jesus say we love Him?
Are His commandments burdensome?
faqs.answer: No; they give the best life on earth.

faqs.question: Can the greatest sin be forgiven?
faqs.answer: Yes, by the blood of Christ.

faqs.question: What did Jesus ask Peter three times?
What does obeying the word bring?
